title:
Epic that pre-populates the `muteDuration` field in the `Manage Alert Status` {@link UiSdlForm}.
This form is displayed when selecting the `Manage Alert Status` action item from a {@link UiSdlDefinitionList}
for either a {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert} or {@link SensorHealthAlert}.

The value is taken from the first (and only) muted period in
{@link AlertMutedPeriodApplicationState#existingMutedPeriods} for the muted entity
(i.e., a {@link ReliabilityMlModel} or {@link Sensor}).
name: PrepopulateManageAlertStatusFormDurationEpic
